name: io.github.houtini-ai/seo-audit-console
description: Merge Google Search Console history with site-crawl data for technical SEO audits, joined on a normalised URL key.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
environmentVariables.description: Path to the Google service-account JSON key with Search Console access.

environmentVariables.name: SAC_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for per-property SQLite databases. Defaults to ~/seo-audits/seo-audit-console.

environmentVariables.name: DATAFORSEO_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: DataForSEO API username (optional, enables SERP/keyword/domain checks).

environmentVariables.name: ENABLED_MODULES
environmentVariables.description: DataForSEO product groups this server may call (the account must have access; DataForSEO is account-level, billed per call). Recommended wider scope: SERP,KEYWORDS_DATA,DOMAIN_ANALYTICS,DATAFORSEO_LABS — Labs powers rank history / over-time sequence data (historical_rank_overview, historical_serps).

environmentVariables.name: DATAFORSEO_CACHE_DAYS
environmentVariables.description: TTL for the DataForSEO response cache. Default 20.
